links.name: GuidelineTitle
links.quote: Measuring Blood Pressure at Clinic Visits

links.name: ReleaseDate
links.quote: January 2026

links.name: DeveloperName
links.quote: Example Primary Care Network

links.name: MainFocus
links.quote: This guideline sets out how blood pressure should be measured in adult primary careclinics so that readings are comparable between visits and between clinicians.

links.name: Users
links.quote: Medical assistants, nurses and physicians

links.name: CareSetting
links.quote: primary care clinics

links.name: InclusionCriterion
links.quote: Adults aged 18 years or older attending a routine clinic visit.

links.name: ExclusionCriterion
links.quote: Pregnant women

links.name: EvidenceTimePeriod
links.quote: from 2010 to 2025

links.name: RecommendationStrengthRatingScheme
links.quote: graded each recommendation as strong or conditional

links.name: ScheduledReview
links.quote: This guideline will be reviewed every three years, or sooner if new evidence appears.

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: Measure blood pressure after the patient has been seated quietly for at least fiveminutes.

links.name: Directive
links.quote: Measure blood pressure after the patient has been seated quietly for at least fiveminutes

links.name: RecommendationStrength
links.quote: Strong recommendation

links.name: EvidenceQuality
links.quote: moderate-quality evidence

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: Use a validated automated device with a cuff sized to the upper arm of the patient.

links.name: Directive
links.quote: Use a validated automated device with a cuff sized to the upper arm of the patient

links.name: RecommendationStrength
links.quote: Strong recommendation

links.name: EvidenceQuality
links.quote: high-quality evidence

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: If the first reading is 140/90 mm Hg or higher, take two further readings one minuteapart and record the average of the last two.

links.name: DecisionVariable
links.quote: the first reading is 140/90 mm Hg or higher

links.name: Action
links.quote: take two further readings one minuteapart and record the average of the last two

links.name: RecommendationStrength
links.quote: Conditional recommendation

links.name: EvidenceQuality
links.quote: low-quality evidence
